location.zh: 加州 Palo Cedro 地区

scope.zh: 地坪、周边梁、6处柱墩/扩大基础、后墙矮基础墙及壁炉基础暂列量；包括普通挖土运土、回填压实、钢筋模板预埋件、泵送、人工、基层、普通排水接缝处理和清理。
scope.en: Slab, perimeter beams, six pedestals/enlarged footings, rear curb and fireplace foundation allowance; ordinary excavation/haul-off, backfill/compaction, reinforcing, formwork, embeds, pumping, labor, base, basic drainage/joints and cleanup.

source.zh: 两页凉亭图纸 A1/S1 的去标识算例；保留原预算数字，客户姓名、地址及原图不纳入此示例。新项目需查看自己的实际图纸。
source.en: De-identified example based on a two-sheet gazebo plan (A1/S1), retaining the historical estimate numbers. Customer identity/address and source drawings are omitted. Inspect the actual drawings for each new project.

tax_note.zh: 未另计销售税/使用税；当地税费及报价包含方式待核实。
tax_note.en: Sales/use tax has not been added. Confirm local taxes and what supplier quotes include.

price_note.zh: 去标识历史示例，费率为当时的预算假设，未取得当地供应商或承包商报价；不是当前价格或固定报价。
price_note.en: De-identified historical example. Rates are unquoted estimating allowances from the original estimate, not current prices or fixed bids.

basis.zh: 全幅毛面积约506.7平方英尺。
basis.en: Full gross area, approximately 506.7 sq ft.

basis.zh: 扣除已计地坪厚度，12英寸地下段加4英寸连接段。
basis.en: Exclude counted slab; 12 in below base plus assumed 4 in connection.

source.zh: S1详图3及平面；84英尺及连接段为暂估
source.en: S1 Detail 3/plan; 84 ft and connection are assumptions

quantities.formula: pedestal_count * ((pad_width_ft * pad_length_ft - pad_overlap_sf) * pad_depth_ft + (pedestal_side_ft * pedestal_side_ft - pedestal_side_ft * beam_width_ft) * base_connection_in / 12 + pedestal_side_ft * pedestal_side_ft * upstand_in / 12) / 27

basis.zh: 底座暂按3英尺方形×12英寸，扣梁及地坪交叠。
basis.en: Assume 3 ft square x 12 in footings; deduct beam/slab overlaps.

source.zh: S1详图2；底座完整尺寸缺失
source.en: S1 Detail 2; full footing dimensions missing

basis.zh: 净长20英尺、宽6英寸、上翻2英寸。
basis.en: 20 ft clear, 6 in wide, 2 in above slab.

source.zh: S1详图1，采用最小上翻假设

basis.zh: 只计基础净增加量，不含壁炉砌筑。
basis.en: Net foundation addition only; fireplace masonry excluded.

source.zh: S1中央局部基础示意，尺寸未全

price_basis.zh: 低/中/高单价为210/230/260美元每立方码，暂含常规运输；泵送和进场附加费单列。
price_basis.en: Low/base/high rates: USD 210/230/260 per yd3, provisionally including standard delivery; pump and mobilization extras separate.

basis.zh: 综合人工包含工资及雇主用工负担。机械土方和泵车已含各自操作员，不在此重复；管理利润另计。每工日按8小时，检查和养护会增加日历工期。
basis.en: Labor includes wages and employer burden. Excavation and pump subcontract allowances include their operators; do not count them again here. Overall overhead/profit is separate. Worker-days use 8 hours; inspections and curing extend calendar duration.

basis.zh: 钢筋暂估0.20-0.35公吨，含损耗；未逐根翻样，基础锚栓含在内。
basis.en: Approx. 0.20-0.35 metric tonnes including waste; not a bar schedule. Foundation anchors included.

basis.zh: 安装拆除人工已在人工项。
basis.en: Installation/stripping labor is in the labor schedule.

basis.zh: 碎石询价7-8立方码；隔潮辅材暂留，图上未明确要求隔汽膜。
basis.en: Allow 7-8 yd3 aggregate; moisture materials provisional, vapor barrier not explicitly specified.

basis.zh: 暂按1-2次进场，含泵车操作员。
机械分包含司机及普通处置；无测量土方及运距资料。
basis.en: Equipment subcontract includes operators/ordinary disposal; earthwork and haul distance unmeasured.

basis.zh: 材料与保护耗材；安装人工已计。
普通耗材及清理，不含特殊检测。

assumptions.zh: 84英尺为估算中心线长度。4英寸基层连接段增加约1.04立方码；审批剖面不需要时应扣除，不得视为图上已确认总深。
assumptions.en: 84 ft is an estimated centerline length. The assumed 4 in connection adds about 1.04 yd3; deduct if not required. It is not a confirmed total depth.

assumptions.zh: 3英尺方形底座不是图上完整标注。每处暂扣3平方英尺梁交叠；柱墩高程和壁炉基础需核实。
assumptions.en: 3 ft square pads are not fully dimensioned on the plan. Deduct an assumed 3 sq ft beam overlap each; verify pedestal elevations and fireplace footing.

assumptions.zh: 示例采用普通土方及正常机械通道；未核地形、岩石或既有泳池铺装修复。
assumptions.en: Assumes ordinary soil and normal access; terrain, rock and pool/paving repairs are unverified.

verification.zh: 核实文件名、项目名、地址及批准图纸是否一致。
verification.en: Reconcile filename, project identity, address and approved drawing set.

verification.zh: 核实柱墩底座长宽深、梁埋深、后墙高度、壁炉重量与基础，以及详图对应分段。
verification.en: Confirm pedestal footing dimensions, beam depth, rear wall height, fireplace load/footing and detail-to-plan mapping.

verification.zh: 确认混凝土强度、配筋、预埋锚件、坡向、排水出口、泵管距离及施工通道。
verification.en: Confirm concrete strength, reinforcement, embeds, slopes/outlets, pump reach and access.

exclusions.zh: 上部木结构、屋顶、墙面、壁炉厨房设备、台面砌筑、泳池、图外露台及地下管线另计。
exclusions.en: Timber superstructure, roof, finishes, fireplace/kitchen equipment, countertop masonry, pool, extra patios and underground services excluded.

exclusions.zh: 设计许可、特殊检测、岩石开挖、软土换填、特殊支护降水及大面积既有设施修复另计。
exclusions.en: Design/permits, special inspections, rock, unsuitable-soil replacement, shoring/dewatering and extensive existing-facility repairs excluded.
